:::{#def-agreement-test-measures}
#### Test measures estimated from an agreement table

Treating the reference as the truth,
an agreement table (@def-agreement-table) estimates
the agent's [sensitivity](#def-sensitivity),
[specificity](#def-specificity),
[positive predictive value](#def-ppv),
and [negative predictive value](#def-npv)
by the matching proportions of its cells:

$$
\ba
\Est{\text{sensitivity}} &\eqdef \frac{a}{a + c}, &
\Est{\text{specificity}} &\eqdef \frac{d}{b + d}, \\
\Est{\text{PPV}} &\eqdef \frac{a}{a + b}, &
\Est{\text{NPV}} &\eqdef \frac{d}{c + d}.
\ea
$$

:::
